messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — Sev 2: high error rate from dedicated cluster halcyon-prod-1 impacting customer Halcyon Logistics (enterprise). Initial spike observed at 2026-03-15T08:12:14Z. Error rate ~22% 5xx for enterprise routes. @Lee please respond.

Lee (oncall): On it. taking pager. quick ask — scope: is this only Halcyon tenant traffic or global?

Anya (SRE): Confirmed: spike is isolated to tenant routing for Halcyon (vhost halcyon-shipflow). Host-level metrics look healthy; routing layer returning 502/504 from our model gateway.

Kevin (eng-sre): Logs show a surge of KV cache misses + routing timeouts hitting the ded. frontend. Sample: ```2026-03-15T08:11:55Z gateway halcyon-shipflow request_id=abc123 error=route_timeout backend=dedicated://halcyon-prod-1```. Investigating whether autoscaler or routing table flapped.

Lee (oncall): Handoff note — previous oncall Sam left a partial mitigation: traffic was being rate-limited to protect pool, and a fallback route to hosted-small was queued but not flipped due to canary gating. I'll finish cutover if needed.

Anya (SRE): Short impact summary for comms: Halcyon experiencing failed contact routing and elevated latencies for their ShipFlow integrations. Customer-visible impact: inability to place new routing requests (50% 5xx for writes), delayed responses for reads (>2s) for the last 20 minutes. Affects Halcyon prod region us-east-1 only.

Maya (customer-success): Preparing a customer notification. Draft below — please review and redact ops-internals as needed.

Maya (customer-success): ```STATUS PAGE DRAFT:

Title: Partial outage affecting Halcyon Logistics routing (US-East)

Time: 2026-03-15 08:12 UTC - Investigating

Details: We are investigating an issue impacting routing requests for one enterprise customer, Halcyon Logistics, in the US-East region. Some API requests are returning errors or experiencing elevated latency. Our engineering team has engaged and is actively mitigating.

Impacted features: contact routing, shipment event ingestion, and admin console routing diagnostics for Halcyon accounts.

Workaround: We have rolled a temporary fallback to our hosted inference variant for affected requests; some requests may still experience brief errors while the routing propagates.

Next update: 30 minutes or earlier.
```

Raj (account-exec): Add a tailored impact note: "ShipFlow webhooks may experience retries and delayed delivery; customers using sync mode should expect order processing delays up to several minutes." Might need to mention SLO impact.

Maya (customer-success): Good call. I'll include SLO note.

Lee (oncall): Proposed internal status (for all hands): ```Internal Incident Update - Halcyon Logistics
Severity: P2 (customer-impacting)
Start: 2026-03-15T08:12Z
Scope: Dedicated cluster halcyon-prod-1 (us-east-1)
Symptoms: 20-25% 5xx on tenant routes, latency >2s
Mitigation in progress: queued fallback route to hosted-small flipped at 08:20Z; monitoring for error reduction
Action items:
 - Kevin: validate routing table consistency and autoscaler events (in progress)
 - Anya: watch error rate + latency (in progress)
 - Maya: notify Halcyon PM/CISO with tailored email (pending)
 - Lee: coordinate rollback if regression observed
```

Kevin (eng-sre): Verified autoscaler did not scale down; there was a routing table mismatch during a reconfiguration push at 08:10Z. Fixing reconciliation now. Post-fallback metrics: error rate dropped from 22% -> 3% within ~90s of traffic switch.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: Canary route flip to hosted-small completed by Lee at 2026-03-15T08:20:05Z.

Anya (SRE): Monitoring shows errors trending down, but a small subset of requests still see 500s due to stale KV tokens — working on clearing cache and warming.

Maya (customer-success): Email template to send to Halcyon primary contacts (please review):

```To: ops@halcyonlogistics.com, secops@halcyonlogistics.com
Subject: Incident: Partial routing outage affecting Halcyon ShipFlow (Mar 15)

Hi Team,

We’re reaching out about an incident impacting routing and shipment event ingestion for Halcyon Logistics in US-East that began at 08:12 UTC. Some API requests returned errors or experienced elevated latency. Our engineers have implemented a temporary fallback to our hosted inference variant which has reduced the error rate significantly.

What we know:
- Impact window started: 2026-03-15 08:12 UTC
- Impact: failed routing requests and delayed delivery for ShipFlow integrations (write-heavy paths most affected)
- Current status: mitigation in place; error rate reduced to ~3% and continues to improve
- Next steps: we will perform a routing table reconciliation and a cache warm to restore pre-incident performance.

If you need immediate assistance or have customers escalations, please reach out to Raj (account lead) at raj@redwood.ai and Lee (oncall) via pager.

Apologies for the disruption — we’re treating this with high priority and will follow up with a detailed post-incident summary.

Thanks,
Maya and SRE team, Redwood Inference
```

Raj (account-exec): I'll ping their PM and CISO, and provide our contact list. Also preparing a short executive note for Halcyon leadership post-mitigation.

Lee (oncall): Operational checklist items done/ongoing: flipped fallback at 08:20, cache clear command scheduled at 08:24, verifying KV warmups. If error rate stays <5% for 15m, we'll mark mitigated and proceed to RCA.

Anya (SRE): Quick note for RCA: capture routing table change at 08:10, autoscaler events, and the canary gate check that prevented earlier fallback flip.

incident-bot: Update status -> Mitigated at 2026-03-15T08:31:00Z. Error rate stabilized ~1.1% for Halcyon tenant. Postmortem assigned: Anya (SRE) owner.

Maya (customer-success): Sent tailored notification to Halcyon ops + secops at 08:35Z (cc Raj). Will follow up with exec note and timeline.

Lee (oncall): Closing the thread after monitoring window. If anyone sees recurrence, re-open or page oncall. :white_check_mark:
